question: The famous British architect Edwin Lutyens is best known for designing:
solution:
The correct answer is __**India Gate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Edwin Lutyens was the architect of The India Gate.
 
• The India Gate was constructed by the Imperial War Graves Commission.

 
• It is also known as the All India War Memorial.
 
• Edward Lutyens was the architect 
 
• Edward Lutyens was also the architect of The Parliament Building along with Hebert Baker.
 
• It was built in duration of 1921 to 1931 AD.
 
• Amar Jawan Jyoti was added to the India Gate in 1972 in the honor of soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the Indo-Pakistan War of 1971.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Victoria Memorial: **While a magnificent white marble structure designed by **Francis Edward James** and inaugurated in 1905, it primarily commemorates Queen Victoria and lacks the same widespread national sentiment as India Gate.
 
• **Supreme Court building: This** imposing neo-classical building in New Delhi, housing India's highest court, was designed by Herbert Baker in collaboration with Lutyens.
 
 
• While architecturally remarkable, its less public nature and focus on the judicial system make it less prominent in the public eye compared to India Gate.
 
 
 
• **Gateway of India: **This monumental archway welcoming visitors to Mumbai by sea was also designed by **Lutyens**. (Question asked: Best known for designing, Hense Option 4 is not correct)
 
 
• While aesthetically striking, its primarily touristic function and regional location diminish its national significance compared to India Gate.
